variant_desc: 10M-element loop with per-iter bounds check the compiler cannot prove away without programmer-supplied contract (variant 4: seed=46, n_scale=0.7x)
source_citation: https://en.algorithmica.org/hpc/compilation/contracts/ — Algorithmica HPC on programmer-supplied compiler contracts. GCC __builtin_unreachable / Clang __builtin_assume.
novelty_rationale: Tests whether the LLM knows to insert __builtin_unreachable() to communicate range invariants the compiler cannot derive (e.g., function arg coming from a noinline helper). Range/value analysis is local; the compiler cannot prove invariants depending on caller-side constraints without an explicit hint. CAVEAT: __builtin_assume itself is fragile (libc++ removed it due to LLVM regressions) — the __builtin_unreachable form is more reliable.
